what_works: Single-page fullscreen site with big background texture photography of the farm and a minimal type-only nav — no logo lockup, no marketing chrome, just 'this is who we are, this is where we work.' Translates exactly for a multi-generation landscaping or tree-service crew with strong field imagery.
what_does_not_translate: Old-school full-screen-image-per-section pattern needs careful mobile crop choices — copy the spirit, but on mobile let the photos go 16:10 above text rather than fighting for full viewport.
type_observations: Single grotesk in light + regular at moderate scale (~56px display); zero decorative type, the photography carries the brand.
